assemblyProvenance.method: From-empty complete native headless receiver followed by learned incoming owner/guide-unit socket grafts

organizationTarget.method: family-calibrated progression kernel over empirical sharp full-field modes; from-empty grammar still required
organizationTarget.difficultyStatus: unmeasured; progression/profile conditioning is not actual difficulty
organizationTarget.profileConditioning: Exact reference scalar count/span/mechanics only; no source parts/coordinates/scaffold copied.

nativeIntegrity.scope: Source atomic asset, rigid macro pose, exact relation/guide closure and optional static composition-body certificate; no collision, active lock, solution, novelty or difficulty claim.

rawGeometry.meaning: Raw polygon/trigger seam screening only, source penetrations calibrated pairwise. Bomb circles approximated with256segments solely for seam screening (maximum radial error radius*(1-cos(pi/256))); actual exported native bomb stays CircleCollider2D. Unity collider skin, casts, bindings and playability remain unverified.

organizationScore.limits: Proposal organization only; not native difficulty or quality.
organizationScore.rankStrategy: held-family evaluated native static composition critic plus learned-standardized soft profile distance

partialSourceReuse.meaning: Multiple native motifs placed with identical source transform restore an exact rigid source subset; evidence is provenance-based and must be independently checked.

organizationScore.qualityProbabilityMeaning: Original-versus-synthetic static arrangement proxy only, not playability or enjoyment.

heuristicNearCopyReviewOnly.limits: Heuristic whole-layout geometry with physical/input orientation equivalences; does not certify intellectual originality or gameplay quality.
